steps.caption: Open Buildings, then Supply, then the Match view.
Choose a requirement — Lumen Harbour Tech, 18,000 to 19,500 sf, up to ₹100 a sf.
#1 Harbour Point floor 4: eligible, availability confidence high, with its fit score and how complete the data is.
The reason in one line: it meets all hard requirements.
Satisfies, advantages, disadvantages and missing information — for example deposit and escalation not recorded.
Harbour Point floor 5 is eligible but its disadvantage says: future availability from April 2027. Unknown CAM is not assumed to be zero.
Riverstone floor 2 needs verification: the availability is stale and the price is out of date.
Riverstone floor 3 only has a lease ending — lease expiry is not vacancy, so it needs verification too.
Lower down, ineligible spaces list exactly which hard filter they fail. They are ranked last, not hidden.
The Requirement button opens the brief to change area, budget or location; the ranking updates.
